plainEnglish: Wiggly packages proven creative formats so an agent can reproduce them for a new brand.
audience: Creators and marketers who want repeatable AI-made creative without rebuilding the workflow each time.
problemBefore: A prompt can make one output, but it does not preserve the full creative process or quality bar.
mechanism: Each Wiggly Format bundles instructions, examples, assets, a runner, and quality checks for an agent to follow.
surprisingTruth: The reusable product is not one generated ad; it is the creative system that can make the next one.

evidence.claim: A Wiggly Format packages instructions, examples, assets, runtime behavior, and quality rules.
An agent skill preserves both execution instructions and creative judgment.
The same Format can produce new outputs for different brands.
